events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A verified suitable reservation was completed: Atlas is confirmed for 'Quarterly planning' tomorrow 10:00-11:00 with 12 people and a projector included, at a $280 CAD all-in total (under the $350 limit). The confirmation page (evidence 13) and My reservations list (evidence 15) show the same details.

Interpretação simulada: The straightforward Atlas path met all stated constraints efficiently: it supplied the required capacity and projector for the available one-hour slot, the $280 all-in total was within the $350 allowance, and both confirmation and My reservations showed the same details.

Limites: This is a demo venue where the footer states reservations are saved only in this browser session. Only Atlas was booked; Willow was listed but not inspected in detail, so no comparison beyond its initial $235/hour rate and 12 seats is claimed.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #11, #13, #15. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Projector and capacity were explicit before confirmation
findings.observation: On the Your meeting step and again on Review, Atlas was listed as Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 for 12 people with 'Projector: Included in your booking'. Review also stated 'Your reservation includes a projector, Wi-Fi, water, and seating for 12.'
findings.expected: A suitable room should make the 12-person and projector requirements verifiable before confirming.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit requirements and charter success criteria: visible saved reservation matches purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget.
findings.personaComment: Seeing 12 people and the projector spelled out meant I didn't have to guess whether Atlas would work.
findings.interpretation: Clear equipment and capacity labelling reduced the need for comparison or recovery in this journey.
findings.uncertainty: This was observed for Atlas only; the other listed room, Willow, was not opened in this journey.

findings.title: All-in total was shown before confirming and stayed within budget
findings.observation: Review itemised Room 1 hour $220, Projector $35 and Service charge $25, for a Total of $280 CAD with 'All charges included'. The confirmation page repeated Reservation total $280.
findings.expected: The complete cost must stay at or below $350 before booking.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's $350 total allowance and charter criterion for an all-in budget check.
findings.personaComment: The breakdown showed $280 all-in, comfortably under my $350 limit, so I could confirm without worrying about extra charges.
findings.interpretation: The transparent all-in total let the persona confirm budget compliance before completing the test reservation.
findings.uncertainty: Prices are from this demo session and screenshot; no claim is made about other dates or rooms.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation was saved and matched the review
findings.observation: Confirmation page said 'You've got a room', marked Atlas Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, $280, reservation GTH-24B5F525. My reservations then listed the same Quarterly planning booking as Confirmed at $280 for Atlas, 12 people, Projector, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00.
findings.expected: A confirmed reservation should be visible and verifiable after booking.
findings.expectedSource: Charter goal to complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details; persona expectation of accurate final details.
findings.personaComment: I could check the same details again in My reservations, so I know the booking is actually saved.
findings.interpretation: The confirmation and saved list agreed, giving a reliable close to the booking task.
findings.uncertainty: The footer notes reservations are saved only in this browser session in this demo venue, so persistence beyond the session was not established.

finding.interpretation: The straightforward Atlas path met all stated constraints efficiently: it supplied the required capacity and projector for the available one-hour slot, the $280 all-in total was within the $350 allowance, and both confirmation and My reservations showed the same details.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Gather home shows my meeting as Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 for 12 people with Projector required. Atlas is listed at $220/hour with 12 seats and Willow at $235/hour with 12 seats, both available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas looks like a good fit on seats and price, so I'll open it to confirm the projector.

experience.observation: The 'Your meeting' step shows a Meeting name field and an Atlas summary: Tomorrow, 10:00-11:00, 12 people, and Projector listed as 'Included in your booking'. No payment details are needed for this demo reservation.
experience.reaction: Great — 12 people and a projector are already confirmed for Atlas, so I'll add our meeting name.

feedback.summary: Atlas summary explicitly confirms the projector is included, so I can proceed without guessing about equipment
feedback.why: The right-hand panel on this screen lists Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, and 'Projector: Included in your booking', matching the core requirements I must meet before spending.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field is focused and empty, with the Atlas summary still showing 12 people and projector included.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning as the meeting name.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field now contains 'Quarterly planning', and the Atlas panel still shows Tomorrow 10:00-11:00 for 12 people with projector included.
experience.reaction: That's the right name, so I'll go to review to check the total before confirming.

experience.observation: Review page shows 'Quarterly planning', seating for 12 and a projector included for Atlas tomorrow 10:00-11:00. Costs are Room $220, Projector $35, Service charge $25, Total $280 CAD, all charges included.
experience.reaction: The $280 total is under my $350 limit and everything matches, so I'll confirm this reservation.

feedback.summary: Itemised review shows a $280 all-in total under the $350 limit, so I can confirm with confidence
feedback.why: The Review page lists Room $220, Projector $35 and Service charge $25 totalling $280 CAD with 'All charges included', alongside Quarterly planning, 12 people and projector included.

experience.observation: Confirmation page says 'You've got a room' with Atlas marked Confirmed: Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, Reservation total $280 CAD, reservation GTH-24B5F525.
experience.reaction: The confirmation looks right, so I'll check it's saved in my reservations.

charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
